project: ScoutOps / 实时选品运营平台

baotaS0.capacity: S0 single host, 100 users and 5-20 concurrent business users

localIdentity.sessionTransport: opaque Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie in production; token hash only in MySQL
localIdentity.delivery: AES-256-GCM MySQL outbox; provider selection pending and explicitly blocked
localIdentity.scope: local email account and own sessions only; MFA and enterprise identity capabilities are tracked separately by M01-02

mfaIdentityAdapters.totp: RFC6238, encrypted seed, replay-resistant time step, single-use recovery codes
mfaIdentityAdapters.challengeTransport: short-lived opaque Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie in production; hash only in MySQL

tenancyContext.dataScope: active organization membership first; workspace must belong to selected organization; session context and audit are synchronous and transactional
tenancyContext.nonGoals: ordinary-user organization creation, RBAC roles/data scopes, team membership and asynchronous tenancy propagation are deferred to their owning modules

authorization.decisionTruth: synchronous MySQL allow and deny audit; default deny; frontend display is not authorization
authorization.nonGoals: resource grants are M01-05; custom roles and assignment UI are not exposed in M01-04

resourceGrants.rules: same active organization membership; exact workspace/type/id/action; reason required; maximum 30 days; expired or revoked grants cannot reactivate
resourceGrants.async: not applicable; expiry and access authorization are synchronous MySQL truth

auditSecurity.seed: one-time Baota-controlled CLI; environment removed after success; no browser or resident service reads seed secrets
auditSecurity.securitySetup: restricted session until forced password change and TOTP enrollment both complete
auditSecurity.permissions: platform or organization audit:read; auditor has no replay, credential, key rotation or role write capability
auditSecurity.audit: synchronous MySQL platform-global or exact-organization events with sanitized metadata and request_id/trace_id
auditSecurity.async: not applicable; seed, security posture and audit authorization are synchronous security truth

designTokensThemes.scope: signed-in user plus server-resolved active organization and workspace
designTokensThemes.truth: versioned synchronous MySQL preference, transactionally paired with audit and idempotency record
designTokensThemes.accessibility: status icon plus text; charts include value, period, source and freshness; keyboard radiogroup and visible focus
designTokensThemes.async: not applicable; preference reads and writes are synchronous and create no Worker, Crawler, queue, file, export, SSE or provider work

authOnboardingPages.contracts: reuses M01-01 local identity, M01-02 MFA and M01-03 tenancy APIs without new fields
authOnboardingPages.nonGoals: no phone login, Google, Microsoft or SSO activation; no onboarding persistence; no new API, migration, environment value or production service

navigationShells.guard: authenticated server-side role and tenancy evaluation with synchronous authorization decision audit
navigationShells.nonGoals: no business metrics, search results, quick-create mutation, notification count, new persistence, async service or environment value

commonUiStates.contracts: semantic text and symbol, safe request/trace identifiers, explicit recovery, fail-closed high-impact confirmation
imageEvidence: P02 contact sheets and M02-01 design tokens
commonUiStates.nonGoals: no API request, business mutation, permission inference, persistence, async service or environment value

globalDiscovery.scope: server-resolved active organization and workspace plus per-document required capability
globalDiscovery.searchProjection: MySQL 5.7 synchronous read model with stable cursor, literal wildcard escaping and internal routes only
globalDiscovery.quickCreate: authorized navigation entries only; no business mutation or optimistic success
globalDiscovery.async: not applicable in M02-05; future resource modules synchronously maintain their own search projections
globalDiscovery.configuration: no new environment values; existing VITE_API_BASE_URL only
imageEvidence: concepts 15 global search, 16 quick create, 17 notification center, 18 message detail

homeAndMobileShell.scope: exact organization and workspace; required capability; health exact authenticated audience user
homeAndMobileShell.truth: synchronous MySQL 5.7 projection read; empty until P03-P05 owning modules write real data
homeAndMobileShell.opportunityDetail: responsive route and section skeleton only; P04 metrics, profit, risk and evidence are not fabricated
homeAndMobileShell.async: not applicable in M02-06; no Worker, Crawler, queue, outbox, event, file, export or SSE
homeAndMobileShell.configuration: no new environment values; existing VITE_API_BASE_URL only

providerRegistry.scope: platform-global technical definitions; organization and workspace columns are intentionally absent
providerRegistry.truth: MySQL 5.7 current definition plus immutable correlated versions and idempotent operations
providerRegistry.permission: authenticated platform provider:configure; same-origin and Idempotency-Key for writes
providerRegistry.async: not applicable in M03-01; collection scheduling, queues, leases and health execution belong to later modules
providerRegistry.configuration: no new environment values or secrets; existing APP_WEB_ORIGIN and MySQL configuration only

credentialAssets.scope: platform-global credential and crawler profile assets; organizations receive later use grants only
credentialAssets.encryption: AES-256-GCM with random nonce, authentication tag, asset/type/key-version AAD and Baota-only master key
credentialAssets.responseBoundary: masked fingerprint and metadata only; no decrypt, export, ciphertext, nonce or auth-tag API
credentialAssets.permission: authenticated platform key_rotation:manage; same-origin and Idempotency-Key for writes
credentialAssets.temporaryMaterialization: authorized Worker/Crawler callback under CREDENTIAL_TEMP_ROOT with finally buffer clearing and exact directory deletion
credentialAssets.masterKeyRotation: resumable Baota one-time re-encryption of current active versions; immutable history becomes unreadable after old-key revocation; switch resident configuration only after zero remaining active old-version assets
imageEvidence: concept 68 key rotation and platform security navigation shell

providerAdapters.scope: platform-global adapter registration and health; collect invocation contract requires organization and workspace scope
providerAdapters.failureBoundary: provider code must have an explicitly registered matching access-mode adapter; otherwise blocked adapter_not_registered
providerAdapters.permission: authenticated platform provider:configure; same-origin and Idempotency-Key for health writes
imageEvidence: concept 62 collection source management table and status layout

playwrightCrawler.scope: platform-global encrypted browser profiles and exclusive leases; every browser run is bound to one organization and workspace
playwrightCrawler.permission: authenticated platform collection:replay; same-origin and Idempotency-Key for expired lease recovery
playwrightCrawler.responseBoundary: profile metadata, lease owner and timing, scoped run counts and correlation only; no credential, ciphertext, lease token, raw plan or temporary path
playwrightCrawler.profileArchive: M03-02 encrypted base64 tar.gz, traversal-safe bounded temporary extraction and unconditional cleanup

downstream.M03-05: collection task queue retry dead letter
downstream.M03-07: real provider URLs selectors and adapters

imageEvidence: concept 63 collection task monitoring table and status layout

collectionTaskStateMachine.scope: organization and workspace scoped task, subquery, attempt, event, outbox and dead-letter truth in MySQL 5.7
collectionTaskStateMachine.retryPolicy: maximum 4 total attempts; 1, 5 and 15 minute backoff plus at most 20 percent jitter; rate limit uses reset time
collectionTaskStateMachine.permission: authenticated platform collection:replay; same-origin Origin, Idempotency-Key and reason for dead-letter replay
collectionTaskStateMachine.responseBoundary: task status, coverage, scoped counts, subqueries, attempts, events, dead-letter and correlation; no target_json, lease token or credential
collectionTaskStateMachine.runtimeBoundary: engine and synthetic live verification only; real Provider executor starts at M03-07 and evidence persistence starts at M03-06

downstream.M03-06: raw evidence normalized records and field provenance

imageEvidence: concept 63 collection task monitoring table, filters, coverage and status layout

evidenceDataQuality.scope: organization and workspace scoped immutable raw evidence, versioned normalized records, field provenance, reconciliation, quality issues, events and outbox in MySQL 5.7 plus Baota-controlled evidence files
evidenceDataQuality.dedupeBoundary: provider-supplied key scoped by organization workspace and provider; identical content replays, different content conflicts
evidenceDataQuality.permission: authenticated platform platform:operate; same-origin Origin, Idempotency-Key and optimistic version for issue resolution; controlled download grants and accesses are audited
evidenceDataQuality.responseBoundary: metadata, normalized versions, provenance and issues only; no raw content, storage path, credential or cookie outside the integrity-checked download endpoint
evidenceDataQuality.runtimeBoundary: persistence and synthetic live verification only; real approved provider URLs, selectors and executors start at M03-07
imageEvidence: concept 39 evidence management table and detail
concept 64 system monitoring metrics and status hierarchy

providerSources.scope: fixed platform source catalog plus organization and workspace scoped replay tasks and evidence
providerSources.admissionBoundary: catalog and provisioning are disabled by default; Google endpoint availability is not production authorization; owners explicitly review and enable provider definitions
providerSources.outboundBoundary: Google News uses one exact code-owned URL template and rejects redirects; CSV uses inline content; callers cannot supply an outbound URL
providerSources.limits: Google RSS 2MB and 20 persisted records per task; CSV 1MB, exact 8-column header, 100 parsed rows and 20 persisted records per task
providerSources.permission: provider:configure for catalog/provision; collection:replay for scoped task creation; writes require same-origin Origin and Idempotency-Key
providerSources.persistence: MySQL 5.7 replay correlation plus M03-05 task/event/outbox and M03-06 immutable evidence, normalized record and field provenance
providerSources.runtimeBoundary: production Worker runs only as a Baota Node project; fixed source adapters are registered in API and Worker; no panel-external service is created
imageEvidence: concept 62 collection source management catalog, status and actions

uiReference.rule: Images define planned visual and page-state references only; contracts, permissions and real data follow the blueprint and implementation.

collectionTask.rule: Multi-source tasks retain every subquery result; insufficient coverage cannot produce an automatic recommendation.

credentials.storage: AES-256-GCM ciphertext in MySQL or Baota-controlled directory; master key only in Baota restricted runtime environment

scaleStages: S1 multi-node after shared storage, Redis/Sentinel, MySQL replica, load balancing and rehearsal
S2 only after capacity and failover rehearsals
